metadata.description: Game development workflow plugin for Claude Code. Falsify un-fun in HTML before touching the engine: 29 skills + 4 domain agents covering 4 axes (time / discipline / validation / integration). v0.3 wires the 4 domain agents into SKILL routing and adds the project-level dev-complete checkpoint. v0.4-v0.5 standardize precondition / agent-routing / sub-flag patterns and complete the half-applied deprecations. v0.6 adds a structural pre-flight guard so future half-applied standards auto-fail. v0.7 promotes the guard's Rule 14 + Rule 13-14-footer checks to FAIL-level, adds three new checks (kit_version consistency, template line-caps, hook API version), Rule 16 kit_version read contract (warn-only on future versions), line-level allowlist precision, and an opt-in pre-push hook. v0.8 closes Rule 17 (pillars.kind enum read contract + Check G), promotes Check B to FAIL with whole-word regex, adds verified-at-SHA stamps to both allowlists for staleness detection, refactors the shader template under the 300-line cap, and formalizes the HANDOFF backlog template to mitigate F21 anchoring. v0.9 annotates Rule 16's three unreachable kit_version rows as safety valves (Protocol 1 narrowed M-2 from 4 false-positive dead branches to 3 genuine ones), closes the last live half-applied field _save_breaking by dropping its single mention (0 readers → 0 mentions), bumps the stale ~28-skills count across 5 doc sites to 29, fills the Protocol 1 corrections ratio tracking table, captures a gmk-port split decision (KEEP at 684 lines with re-open triggers), and produces a v1.0 backward-compat inventory enumerating six categories of v0.x guarantees as deliberate-break candidates. Fourth consecutive ACCURATE release. dev-complete is a release-readiness checkpoint — release and live-ops are out of scope by design.

roadmap / brainstorm / task-split / status / loop / prototype-rules / shape-advisor / portability-check / mechanic-merge / kill-milestone / mock-inject / design-system / content-plan / prototype / refactor-check / art-spec / art-gen / sound-plan / ux-flow / narrative / save-migrate / validate / self-test / regression / platform-check / merge-gate / port / dev-complete) + 4 domain agents (systems-designer / feel-engineer / economy-balancer / playtest-analyst). v0.3 wires the 4 agents into SKILL routing. v0.4 standardized Rule 13-15 across 27 skills + 7 sub-flag catalogs + 9 deprecated trace fields. v0.5 hotfixed 7 v0.4 regressions. v0.6 adds scripts/check-plugin-meta.sh structural pre-flight (Rule 14 token / endpoint terminology / Rule 13-14 footer) so future half-applied standards auto-fail. v0.7 promotes Rule 14 + Rule 13-14-footer checks to FAIL-level, adds three new checks (D kit_version consistency / E template line-cap / F hook API version), Rule 16 kit_version read contract (warn-only on future-version files, per shape (d)), line-level allowlist precision, and an opt-in scripts/hooks/pre-push hook. v0.8 adds Rule 17 (pillars.kind enum read contract) + Check G, promotes Check B to FAIL with whole-word regex tightening, adds verified-at-SHA staleness stamps to both allowlists, refactors templates/prototype-shader.html under the 300 soft cap, adds a mock-asset cleanup reminder to gmk-art-gen, and formalizes a HANDOFF backlog candidate template to mitigate F21 anchoring. v0.9 annotates Rule 16's three unreachable kit_version rows as safety valves following the v0.7 Rule 14 CYCLE pattern (Protocol 1 narrowed M-2 from 4 false-positive branches to 3 genuine ones; early_fail, Math.random, and CYCLE confirmed live or already-closed), closes the last live half-applied field _save_breaking via Path-(b) drop (0 readers → 0 mentions, half-applied class is now empty), bumps the stale ~28-skills count across 5 doc sites (README:6/43/192, CONCEPT:111/409), fills the Protocol 1 corrections ratio tracking table (v0.9 = 3.0), produces a gmk-port split decision artifact (KEEP at 684 lines with documented re-open triggers), and produces the v1.0 backward-compat inventory enumerating six categories of v0.x guarantees as deliberate-break candidates for the MAJOR bump. Fourth consecutive ACCURATE release. MAST-aligned safety: one-way log verification via playtest-analyst, no agent-to-agent calls, max-iteration=1. Calibrated for 2D / deterministic input / sessions ≤5min. Zero external accounts, zero API keys.
